ideas.name: Forward Discount Carry Portfolio
ideas.claim: Sort currencies into six portfolios by month-end forward discount, then hold a long position in the highest-discount portfolio and a short position in the lowest-discount portfolio.
ideas.quote: The zero cost strategy that goes long in portfolio 6 and short in portfolio 1 (the high-minus-low strategy H/L) is labelled carry trade portfolio.

rules.market: Foreign currencies against the US dollar; the paper's portfolios include currencies beyond FX majors.
rules.entry: At month-end, rank currencies by forward discount, allocate them to six portfolios, and go long portfolio 6 and short portfolio 1.
rules.exit: After one month; portfolios are formed again using the next month-end ranking.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper measures carry portfolio returns across monetary conditions; a result for an FX-majors-only portfolio is not stated.
